logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

moments.description: Prudence violently bursts through the barn doors, sobbing and begging Lady Juliana to save her dying brother.
moments.key_dialogue: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

moments.description: Prudence bitterly reveals that the local apothecary shut his door and the manor doctor laughed because they lack silver.
moments.key_dialogue: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

moments.description: Prudence drops desperately to her knees in the hay, pleading for Lady Juliana to save her seven-year-old brother.
moments.key_dialogue: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

moments.description: Toby's dangerous wheezing suddenly stops as he slips into peaceful breathing, bringing Prudence to tears of relief.
moments.key_dialogue: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

moments.description: Prudence expresses deep resentment toward the manor residents who ignore the poor in their luxury.
moments.key_dialogue: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

moments.description: Prudence reveals that the Dowager Duchess is secretly dying of a mysterious illness, leaving Lady Juliana staring at her mother's ledger in stunned realization.
moments.key_dialogue: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.
